get_card.description: Get a single trading card by its id and season. Choose which aspects to include: card info, owners, market asks/bids, and trade history.
get_card.name: get_card

parameters.description: The card's numeric id (a nation's database id).
parameters.name: card_id

parameters.description: The card season (the current season is 4).
parameters.name: season

parameters.description: Which parts of the card to return.
parameters.name: aspects

get_card_collection.description: Get a trading card collection by its id, including the cards in it.
get_card_collection.name: get_card_collection

parameters.description: The collection's numeric id.
parameters.name: collection_id

get_card_deck.description: Get a nation's trading card deck: the cards it owns plus a summary of its bank, deck value, and rank.
get_card_deck.display_str_template: Get the card deck for NationStates nation {0}.
get_card_deck.name: get_card_deck

parameters.description: The nation's name, e.g. 'Testlandia'.

get_dispatch.description: Get a single dispatch by its id, including its full text.

DISPATCH.AUTHOR: testlandia

DISPATCH.TITLE: Regional Roleplay Guide

get_dispatch.name: get_dispatch

parameters.description: The dispatch's numeric id.
parameters.name: dispatch_id

parameters.description: Which fields to return. Defaults to a general summary.
parameters.name: shards

get_poll.description: Get a regional poll by its id, including its current results.
get_poll.name: get_poll

parameters.description: The poll's numeric id.
parameters.name: poll_id

get_region.description: Look up public data about a region. Choose which fields (shards) to return, such as its delegate, founder, population, power, tags, and officers.

parameters.description: The region's name, e.g. 'The Pacific'.

parameters.description: The region's name, e.g. 'The Pacific'.

parameters.description: Which World Census statistic to rank by.
parameters.name: scale

parameters.description: How many posts to return (1-100).

get_wa_resolution.description: Get a World Assembly resolution with its voting detail. Leave the resolution id blank for the one currently at vote, or give an id for a past resolution.

parameters.description: Which World Assembly council to query.
parameters.name: council

parameters.description: A past resolution's id. Leave blank for the resolution currently at vote.
parameters.name: resolution_id

get_world.description: Get world-wide data: the total number of nations and regions, the featured region, the newest nations, and the latest event id.
get_world.name: get_world

parameters.description: Which world fields to return.

get_world_assembly.description: Get data about a World Assembly council (General Assembly or Security Council): member and delegate counts, lists, current proposals, the last resolution, and recent happenings.

get_world_census_ranks.description: Get the world-wide leaderboard for a World Census statistic: every nation ranked by that statistic, 20 at a time.

parameters.description: Optional site-specific token, if you generated the code with one.

description: Access NationStates' keyless public data API: look up nations and regions, World Census statistics and leaderboards, the World Assembly (General Assembly and Security Council), dispatches, polls, regional message boards, world happenings, trading cards, and login verification. No account or API key required.
